messages:
maya: Quick sync — PR #4820 (runtime image tag bump) is ready but needs a coordinated merge across runtime / api / console / sdk. Helm chart in infra/helm-apps references the runtime image tag so we need an ordering. Can folks chime in who can review/approve the API and SDK pieces? Link: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/4820 :gear:
aj: Thanks. Can you paste the minimal merge order you want? Also any gating CI we should wait for?
maya: Proposed order: 1) runtime (push image + set tag) 2) api (compatibility + swagger bump) 3) helm chart in infra (update values.image.tag) 4) console (point at new api) 5) sdk (client bump + release). Reason: runtime image must exist before helm/cluster upgrade, api change needs to be live before console and sdk consumers.
liam: SGTM. I'll take runtime review today. Runtime CI is green locally but we should wait for canary pipeline: `pipeline/canary-runtime` to be green. deploy-bot: pipeline/canary-runtime: started for commit sha abc123...
sophie: I can review API change — quick note: the API adds an optional query param that SDK needs to tolerate. If API keeps backwards compatible defaults, console should be fine.
aj: SDK heads-up: this will require a tiny client patch to accept the new optional param (no behavioral change when missing). I'll prepare a draft PR in sdk repo and mark it WIP, link when ready.
maya: Thanks. Also infra/helm change is nontrivial: we need a new value schema for image args. Sample snippet I used in staging:```yaml
image:
  repository: gcr.io/redwood/runtime
  tag: "v2024-11-12-rc"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
``` Please ensure chart's values.yaml has the new keys.
liam: noted. For safety let's do the helm upgrade with `--atomic --timeout 10m` in staging first. I'll run the staging canary after runtime image is pushed.
sophie: CI note: api/integration-tests currently flaky on job api-e2e-db-setup. I'll rerun after a fix; expect green in ~30m.
maya: Plan: aim to merge tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll gate final merges on: runtime canary green + api e2e green + infra helm dry-run OK + 2 approvals on api and infra. Can someone own infra helm review?
aj: I can review infra/helm values after runtime is merged. I'll also hold a quick checklist in the sdk PR to indicate dependency.
liam: runtime done from my side, pushed image sha abc123, canary pipeline passed: :white_check_mark: deploy-bot: pipeline/canary-runtime: succeeded for abc123.
maya: Awesome — AJ, Sophie, once API + infra are green let's coordinate the actual merge window (I can babysit merges to ensure order). Also I'll hold off merging sdk until console integration test runs against the new API endpoint and we cut a client release.
aj: WIP SDK PR created: https://git.redwood/sdk/pull/210 — includes client accept-new-param and tests. Marking DNM until api is merged.
sophie: API PR updated, reran e2e, now green :white_check_mark:. Two approvals from @sophie and @alex (alex gave LGTM offline).
maya: Great. Infra helm dry-run looks good with `helm template --set image.tag=v2024-11-12-rc`. No manifest diffs besides image tag change.
liam: I'm going to perform runtime -> api merge now during the window. I'll announce in #eng-oncall if anything pops.
maya: Merge sequence executed: runtime merged -> api merged -> infra helm PR merged -> helm upgrade started in staging (atomic) -> console PR merged -> sdk PR merged and cut release. All good so far.
aj: Cut SDK release v1.14.3 and published. Notifying downstream teams.
sophie: Monitoring logs for errors, nothing unusual. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks everybody — leave any follow-ups here. Next time we might script the ordering with a tiny orchestration job to auto-check canary + run helm dry-run before advancing.
aj: +1 on scripting. I'll sketch a small runbook and a script that checks pipeline statuses and runs `helm template` before unblocking merges.
liam: Saved the checklist in the PR description for future runs.
maya: Closing the loop — marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
